item.title: ESPN to Replace ‘Sunday Night Baseball’ with ‘Women’s Sports Sundays’
item.description: ESPN is going all in on women's sports, with the broadcast giant planning to debut 'Women's Sports Sundays' this summer. The post ESPN to Replace ‘Sunday Night Baseball’ with ‘Women’s Sports Sundays’ appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Dominant 2025/26 Champions League Runs Set Up Quarterfinal Derbies
item.description: Half of the 2025/26 UEFA Champions League quarterfinals will feature league rivalries, as February's Round of 16 locked in the next UWCL round this week. The post Dominant 2025/26 Champions League Runs Set Up Quarterfinal Derbies appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: SEC Titans Headline ESPN NCAA Women’s Basketball Triple-Header
item.description: An SEC showdown is taking over Sunday, with ESPN airing a ranked triple-header highlighting the NCAA basketball season's penultimate weekend. The post SEC Titans Headline ESPN NCAA Women’s Basketball Triple-Header appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Figure Skater Alysa Liu Wins Olympic Gold, Ends U.S. Medal Drought
item.description: Snapping a 20-year medal drought for US figure skating, Alysa Liu claimed 2026 Olympic gold with Thursday's dominant free skate. The post Figure Skater Alysa Liu Wins Olympic Gold, Ends U.S. Medal Drought appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: USA Hockey Tops Canada in Overtime Thriller to Win Olympic Gold
item.description: US women's hockey won Olympic gold on Thursday, earning the team's third-ever gold medal in a dramatic 2-1 overtime victory over Canada. The post USA Hockey Tops Canada in Overtime Thriller to Win Olympic Gold appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Jessica Pegula Survives Amanda Anisimova to Book 2026 Dubai Final
item.description: Jessica Pegula rallied to defeat Amanda Anisimova 1-6, 6-4, 6-3 in the Dubai Championships semifinals, booking her tournament final ticket. The post Jessica Pegula Survives Amanda Anisimova to Book 2026 Dubai Final appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Canada Hockey Captain Marie-Philip Poulin Battles Injury in Olympic Final Heartbreaker
item.description: Canada hockey captain Marie-Philip Poulin settled for Olympic silver on Thursday, playing through injury as Canada fell to Team USA 2-1. The post Canada Hockey Captain Marie-Philip Poulin Battles Injury in Olympic Final Heartbreaker appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Olympic Gold Medalist Alysa Liu and Family Were Once Targeted by Chinese Spies
item.description: US figure skater Alysa Liu and her father were targeted in a Chinese spying operation, four years before she won gold at the 2026 Olympics. The post Olympic Gold Medalist Alysa Liu and Family Were Once Targeted by Chinese Spies appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Coco Gauff Falls to Elina Svitolina in Epic Three-Hour Dubai Semifinal Battle
item.description: Coco Gauff fell to Elina Svitolina in Friday's three-set Dubai semifinal, setting up a Saturday final between Svitolina and Jessica Pegula. The post Coco Gauff Falls to Elina Svitolina in Epic Three-Hour Dubai Semifinal Battle appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: U.S. Speed Skater Kristen Santos-Griswold Disqualified for Causing 1,500-Meter Short Track Crash
item.description: Olympic speed skater Kristen Santos-Griswold was disqualified from the 1,500-meter short track, after her illegal lane pass caused a crash.
